title: Atomic Market
tagline: Decentralized quantum prediction market using LMSR curves and Chainlink oracles.
description: Atomic Market is a decentralized quantum prediction market platform that introduces a groundbreaking concept — Quantum Markets, where outcomes are interconnected and conditional, allowing users to express multi-dimensional opinions across different prediction tracks. It leverages LMSR (Logarithmic Market Scoring Rule) bonding curves for dynamic and manipulation-resistant pricing, ensuring efficient capital utilization and fair market outcomes. The platform integrates Chainlink oracles for secure real-world data communication and employs AI-powered validation and resolution through autonomous agents.
how_its_made: Made using Solidity and Hardhat including Chainlink oracle for market resolution. The dynamics of this market is using using LMSR curve and combination of Conditional Prediction Market and Quantum Market which effectively boosts prediction. By combining conditional prediction logic, blockchain decentralization, and quantum-inspired market modeling, Freedom of Prediction pioneers a next-generation prediction ecosystem that is transparent, autonomous, and capital-efficient.
